items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: they’re learning Schoenberg, they’re learning Stravinsky.

ctx.x: The most representative art music. Period. It represents what American music has led to. If you look at it structurally, think about somebody who is really jazz interested and they’re black and they’re getting university training and it’s the fifties. What were they trained in? They’re interested in jazz so they’re playing that. But they are learning music theory, they’re learning Schoenberg, they’re learning Stravinsky.
